notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.notes:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on July 18th.
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

Early Access and Beyond
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.notes:
Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4
https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with two pleasant surprises.

Firstly, Die Young is now available on the PlayStation Store. We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on PS4 in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on PS5, your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

Secondly, we have not forgotten about our PC fans. Die Young just got updated on Steam. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Русский язык, Idioma español, cards & more in Die Young patch 1.0.30.20!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/da036d4efbcfee2c58222afcea03af587dd7b801.jpg
Hi Everybody!

Today we are very proud to announce a majore release patch for Die Young.
1.0.30.20 where many things were added, 
the most important are RUSSIAN and SPANISH languages!

Since its release the 12 of September, thousands of you played Die Young and we are very happy.

We are still finalizing Italian ( it's our native language so we want to make things right ;-) ) and it should be ready for next week when also official soundtrack will be released.

We also add Trading cards in this patch, we hope you like it!

Full changelog 1.0.30.20

 added Russian language
 added Spanish language
 The executioner now despawns after crossing Underworld Passage
 Now the Executioner keys (Blood-soaked Keys) also open the gates of the passage that directly connects Dry Riverbed and Stone Pillars.
 fix of some quests that were not completed correctly
 graphix fixes/ improvements on several textures
 graphix fixes/ improvements on several npc animations
 graphix fixes/ improvements on several first person animations
 further level and geometry optimization.

notes.title: Tyler Patch released
notes.notes:
Hi guys, we are happy to announce that we released the patch for Tyler. Below the list of the features:

- Implemented the custom Keyboard and Mouse mapping.
- Tyler now supports joypads non XInput compliant.
- Updated and Improved the ingame tutorial.
- Various bug fixes.

Please try it and let us know for any issue and request.
We really hope that you'll enjoy it.

Cheers

DevTeam
